shots.name: proposed-plan-rows
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]'); return !!b && b.dataset.planStatus==='proposed' && b.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-step-title]').length===3 && document.body.innerText.includes('Review the auth module before the release');})()

shots.name: proposed-step-opened
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]'); return !!b && b.dataset.planStatus==='proposed' && b.innerText.includes('stops at its');})()

shots.name: proposed-plan-no-sentence
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]'); return !!b && b.dataset.planStatus==='proposed' && b.innerText.includes('Review the six files that changed in the auth module');})()

shots.name: running-plan-rows
shots.expect: js:(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]'); return !!b && b.dataset.planStatus==='running' && b.innerText.includes('up to') && b.innerText.includes('done');})()
